entities.name: Kościuszko Uprising
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Kościuszko Uprising, a transformative movement in Poland (1700–1795). Emerged from Bar Confederation and Jan III Sobieski's relief of the Siege of Vienna. Catalyzed Third Partition (1795) — Poland ceases to exist and Constitution of May 3, 1791 — first modern European constitution.
